title: Volare
description: A Technical modpack focused around Create: Aeronautics!
body:
> One day, strange meteors rained down from the skies above and shattered the world, leaving behind only shards strewn across an empty abyss. Gather materials, build your ships to travel the void, adapt, and overcome.

Volare! is a technical modpack built around Create: Aeronautics. In this modpack, the entire overworld has been turned into floating islands. You'll need to build airships that work as mobile bases in order to explore the overworld and beat the game!

Note this modpack is still in development. I'll be tweaking it as I go along, so stay tuned!
